July Black Friday deals continue, with AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 still at $100 off (if you missed out last week), and AirTag 2 maintaining its all-time low price. However, today's 9to5Toys noon flash focuses on this M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB with $500 off, and this 48GB model with $400 off. Also, the Twelve South PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My is at an Amazon low of $40; Nanoleaf's biggest sale of the year final chance—smart lighting at shocking prices, mirror lights, desk lamps starting from $25; an exclusive discount on the new American leather MacBook backpack; and the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 with $100 off. M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB $500 off, 48GB model $400 off and more deals

In addition to ongoing July Black Friday deals like $50 off AirPods Pro 3 and $100 off all colors of AirPods Max 2, the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup continues to see significant discounts. This round's highlights include $500 off the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro 14-inch model from Amazon, and $400 off this 48GB model from B&H.

This is arguably the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal since the price hike took effect, with Amazon dropping the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro to $2,499 with shipping. Originally priced at $2,999, this model with 24GB RAM and 2TB storage is $500 below the new pricing.

This deal is particularly great value because Apple just raised the price of this configuration by $400, and even before the price hike, Amazon never went below $2,340.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro discounts is B&H's 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model, going for as low as $2,799 with shipping. Although the doubled RAM raises the price, it's $400 off compared to the $3,199 list price, and this configuration is completely unavailable on Amazon.

Twelve South PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to Amazon low of $40

The Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C charger with Apple Find My is now discounted to $40 on Amazon, nearly 45% off the original price.

Amazon is currently selling the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C wall charger for $39.99 with shipping.

This product originally launched at $70, then dropped in price, with Twelve South adjusting the MSRP to $50. For most of this year it hovered around $55 on Amazon, and has now dropped to its 2026 low. During this year's Prime Day it briefly dipped to slightly above $40.

Beyond its unique and clean appearance, this charger is essentially a practical everyday carry and travel companion, with a slim body featuring two bottom-mounted USB-C plugs that charge your devices anywhere there's an outlet.

It comes with foldable prongs for easy storage and portability, with a maximum output of 50W, but the real highlight is the built-in Apple Find My functionality. Like other third-party Find My devices, it quickly connects to the Find My app, providing standard location tracking and left-behind notifications—especially reassuring for a charger that you're constantly taking in and out of your bag on the go.

To learn more about its features and user experience, check out my hands-on Twelve South PlugBug review.

Grab the July Black Friday Apple Watch Series 11 deal, starting from $299 while supplies last ($100 off)

There's still plenty of summer left, so if you're looking to get a new Apple wearable, you'll want to act while the popular Series 11 models still have $100 off.

Over the past week we've seen plenty of special deals on higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, but if you're after the most affordable—and frankly what I consider the best value—model, the basic version with $100 off is the one to get:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

As of this morning's deadline, Amazon's basic aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models still have $100 off. However, we're starting to see some case colors for the larger 46mm go out of stock, so keep an eye on the situation before prices bounce back.

These deals are roughly on par with the best records since the products launched, with only some models during June Prime Day being $20 cheaper than today. With July Black Friday deals expected to start winding down this weekend, discounts on the Apple Watch Series 11 are likely to follow—and we're already starting to see this happen.
